points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving reliability of automated documentation and troubleshooting workflows.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of information for AI-assisted DevSecOps.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring secure and compliant code generation.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling efficient log analysis.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for pipelines, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, improving security coverage and automated risk assessment.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI automation tools using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust integration with CI/CD pipelines.
